title: State Immunization Registry Reporting Note for Immunization Services
content:
Every Immunization Services dose given at Kestrel is reported to the state immunization registry of the store's state.

## Reporting deadline
A dose is reported no later than the date the dose was given plus the vaccination's registry report deadline days, counted in calendar days with the dose date as day 0. The last day of the deadline is itself within the deadline.

## One report per dose
Each dose is reported once. A dose later invalidated stays reported, and the invalidation is noted by the pharmacist directly with the registry.

## Deadline worked through (hypothetical dates)

| Deadline days | Dose given | Last day to report | Report on | Within the deadline? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | Day 0 (a Monday) | Day 3 (Thursday) | Day 3 | Yes |
| 3 | Day 0 (a Monday) | Day 3 (Thursday) | Day 4 | No |
| 1 | Day 0 | Day 1 | Day 1 | Yes |
| 1 | Day 0 | Day 1 | Day 2 | No |

## Points of judgement

- Reports go to the registry of the state where the store that gave the dose is located.
- A dose already reported is not reported a second time, including after it is found not to count.
